name: stint-claude-demo-allowance
description: Shows a Stint session funded by an owner's allowance on the Subscriptions & Allowances program: rent 100 s of a live Solana account stream over x402 on devnet, pulled from the owner, top it up, close it early with the rest refunded to the owner, and see the chain refuse a launch past the cap.

tools.name: stint_allowance_demo
tools.description: Shows the Stint allowance demo panel

tools.name: stint_allowance_demo_state
tools.description: The demo's state, for the panel

tools.name: stint_allowance_demo_launch
tools.description: Opens a 100 s session, pulled from the owner's allowance

tools.name: stint_allowance_demo_top_up
tools.description: Buys 100 s more, pulled from the owner's allowance

tools.name: stint_allowance_demo_close
tools.description: Closes the session now, refunding the rest to the owner

wallet_dir.title: Wallet folder
wallet_dir.description: The agent's devnet key (agent.json) is kept in a stint-demo-allowance folder inside the one you pick, made if missing. It holds nothing: the owner's allowance funds it.

gate_url.title: Gate URL
gate_url.description: The seller's gate: the example seller deployment by default.

owner.title: Owner's address
owner.description: The address of the owner who grants the agent its allowance with pnpm stint allowance grant.

nonce.title: Allowance nonce
nonce.description: The --nonce of the grant: leave empty for 0.
